_comment: WF-V6 V6-1 item 2 — PRIOR CARD for the school bus: real-world dimensions (soft plausibility only; the turnaround wins) + the STYLISATION ratio measured off subjects/school_bus/turnaround (scripts/v6/bus-experiment.mjs re-measures it and reports it). Anchor: the body width W is the one real dimension kept (it fixes the metric scale of the orthos); every other body dimension comes from the turnaround.

real.source: North American school bus Type C / Type D (Blue Bird Vision / All American published specs, rounded)

anchor.why: road-legal width: the one proportion a stylised bus keeps; fixes px/m of the turnaround

stylisation._comment: measured on the turnaround (body paint spans; H = overall incl. wheels): the concept is a deliberately CHIBI bus

softRanges._comment: FIT knob ranges (m) = the stylised card widened to the real card: a soft plausibility box, never a target
